title: Surreal Melting Eye Dream
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a massive multicolored eye with dripping paint at the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. Below, a green dog with yellow spots stands on a yellow flower field behind a wooden fence, surrounded by large dripping peonies, while a blue-skinned face, orange dragon, and white flowers float in the swirling composition.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting featuring a giant multicolored eye dripping paint at the center of a swirling cosmic vortex of blue and purple. In the foreground a green dog with yellow spots stands in a yellow flower field behind a wooden fence. Large red, orange and yellow peonies with dripping paint effects, a blue-skinned face, orange dragon-like creature, white flowers and smaller houses in a misty rural background, vibrant colors, detailed fantasy illustration.
